chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The divorce of the pregnant woman is one (revocation), and her waiting period is that she gives birth to her load, and it is the closer of the two periods.

key_terms.تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا: She gives birth to her load

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period (Iddah) for a pregnant woman who is divorced according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the iddah of a pregnant woman is solely determined by the delivery of her child, resolving the juristic debate between the two potential waiting periods. This ruling highlights the principle of 'aqarab al-ajalain' (the nearer of the two terms), ensuring the woman is not burdened with an indefinite wait while also guaranteeing the paternity of the child is established. It serves as a foundational text in Shia fiqh for understanding the unique status of pregnancy in marital dissolution.
